small_features.title: Add character-base-image task to Image node
small_features.user_visible_behavior: Users can select Task 1 on an Image node, enter a character appearance and personality/action description, and receive the supplied local character-base image in one connected result node.
acceptance_criteria: The Image task selector includes Task 1 Character base image.
Task 1 has separate editable character appearance and personality/action text inputs.
Completion renders the supplied image as an explicitly provided local preview, not a model result or persisted asset.
Completion creates one compatible source-to-result edge and rerunning does not duplicate the result or edge.
Existing Image prompt, upload, and edit controls remain available.

small_features.title: Implement SeedDream text-to-image graph foundation
small_features.user_visible_behavior: Users can generate a single image from the unified Image node with backend-confirmed SeedDream provider/model evidence and honest no-persistence labeling.
acceptance_criteria: The Add menu exposes one Image node instead of separate Character Image, Prop / Asset, and Scene Image generation nodes.
Generate posts to the local FastAPI backend and never exposes Doubao credentials in frontend code.
Backend SeedDream config uses DOUBAO_API_KEY, DOUBAO_BASE_URL, SEEDREAM_MODEL, and optional DOUBAO_HTTPS_PROXY.
Provider code exposes submitSeedreamWithRetry() and submitSeedreamGenerationOnce() wrappers.
A successful generation creates or updates one deterministic image outcome node on the canvas.
The image outcome node renders the returned image URL or image data and displays provider/model evidence.
AI modify or other unavailable image-node functions show a visible not-implemented message instead of silently pretending to work.
Verification covers backend provider/route tests, frontend tests, typecheck/build, and rendered interaction or E2E evidence.

small_features.title: Make image nodes self-contained for text, upload, and image edit
small_features.user_visible_behavior: The unified Image node displays its own current image and updates in place from connected text prompts, typed prompts, uploads, or image-plus-prompt SeedDream edits.
acceptance_criteria: The unified Image source node renders as an image-bearing node with an empty placeholder state, generated/uploaded preview state, and provider/model/no-persistence evidence in the node itself.
Connected upstream text from Script or other text output nodes can seed the image prompt and be used for generation.
If the Image node has no current image, the below-node AI composer prompt generates a new image through the local SeedDream backend.
If the Image node already has a generated or uploaded image, the below-node AI composer sends prompt plus the current image reference to the local backend for SeedDream image editing.
Users can upload a local reference image into the selected Image node; upload remains local preview only and is labeled as not persisted.
Successful generation or edit updates the selected Image node itself instead of creating a separate image outcome node.
Frontend still calls only local FastAPI image routes and does not expose Doubao credentials.
Unavailable durable asset persistence, storage, signed URLs, queues, and history are labeled honestly.
Tests and rendered QA cover connected-text prompt seeding, prompt-only generation, uploaded/reference-image edit request shape, in-place node preview rendering, and no separate outcome node creation.
